name: AI Banking Application — DevOps Capstone
description: A DevOps capstone focused on infrastructure provisioning, containerized workloads, Kubernetes deployments, GitOps and observability.
highlights: Provisioned infrastructure with Terraform and deployed workloads using Docker and Kubernetes manifests.
Implemented GitOps with Argo CD, using GitHub as the source of truth with automated reconciliation and drift detection.
Automated CD; resume-reported deployment time reduced from 10–12 minutes to 2–3 minutes.
Configured Cert-Manager, AWS Secrets Manager and IRSA as part of workload security; set up Prometheus and Grafana observability.
Resume-reported 99% SLI uptime and a reduction in incidents from 24 to 2–3 per year.
